ValidationRule.description: IM-76: Breakout Foundation code can only have Budgeted Initiative Foundation Code as a Parent.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Foundation_Code_Validation__c && AND( ISPICKVAL( Type__c ,'Breakout'), NOT(ISBLANK(Parent__c)), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Parent__r.Type__c ,'Budgeted Initiative')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Breakout Foundation code can only have Budgeted Initiative Foundation Code as a parent.
